entities.name: Spice Isles
entities.description: Chain of sparsely populated islands in the Domains of Dominaria, west of Aerona, used by sailors as rest stops.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: Continent east of the Spice Isles.

entities.name: Sheoltun Empire
entities.description: Empire that conquered the Spice Isles from the pirates.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Realm that assumed control of the Spice Isles.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: Place that became the home of the Spice Isles during the Time Spiral crisis.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: Haven for planeswalkers in the Spice Isles shielded by Thran metal.

entities.name: Thran metal
entities.description: Nearly indestructible, perpetually growing metal created by the Thran in the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Time Spiral crisis
entities.description: Crisis during which the isles became home of Tolaria West.

events.summary: The Spice Isles, ruled by pirates, are conquered by the Sheoltun Empire.
events.quote: ruled by pirates before they were conquered by the Sheoltun Empire

events.summary: Benalia assumes control of the Spice Isles.
events.quote: Later, Benalia assumed control over them.

events.summary: Benalia loses its hold during the Rift Era but reestablishes itself in the Mending Era.
events.quote: Benalia lost its hold during the Rift Era

relations.quote: Within the present-day Spice Isles, a haven for planeswalkers exists called Sanctum.

relations.note: Benalia assumed control over the islands.
relations.quote: Later, Benalia assumed control over them.
